rule.statement: Proceedings cannot be invalidated due to non-appointment of legal representatives when a party failed to file a memorandum of nominees.
rule.supporting_quote: As per section 81(9) and (10) of the Partition Act, proceedings cannot be invalidated due to non-appointment of legal representatives when a party failed to file a memorandum of nominees.
rule.statute_citation_verbatim: section 81(9) and (10) of the Partition Act
